summary: Blue Moon Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing operational milestones for its Nussir copper-silver-gold project in Norway: award of an EPC contract to MOMEK Services AS for the processing plant, approval of the Mine Waste Management Plan and amended discharge permit by the Norwegian Environment Agency, and approval of the updated mine operating plan by the Norwegian Directorate of Mines. No financial terms, price, premium, or board recommendations were disclosed. The filing is a routine operational update on regulatory permits and construction progress, not a special situation.
